source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Fairly few modifiable factors having actually been established for stroke prevention at the population level","B":"Stroke prevention being considered relevant mainly to older adults, rather than to younger clients as well","C":"Managing blood pressure, avoiding smoking, managing diabetes, and maintaining a healthy lifestyle to reduce stroke risk","D":"Disregarding family history entirely, on the reasoning that a client's genetic background cannot be changed"}}
source_row.rationale: Community stroke risk factor education emphasizes the importance of managing blood pressure, avoiding smoking, managing diabetes, and maintaining a healthy lifestyle, messages relevant across age groups given that stroke can occur at any age.
source_row.source_name: AHA/ASA — Stroke Risk Factor Community Education
